title: GET /api/hackatime/v1/users/:id/statusbar/today, 200
description: HackatimeController#status_bar_today (hackatime_controller.rb lines 78-108): the seconds of today's heartbeats in the user's time zone, as duration_seconds counts them, and the text an editor's status bar shows for them. The text follows the user's status bar setting: for simple_text it is 'Start coding!' at 0 and short_time_simple otherwise, such as '1h 5m', with ' / <target> goal' after it when the user shows a daily goal there (user.rb lines 354-367; application_helper.rb lines 44-49). goal is there only when the user has a daily goal, with the progress ProgrammingGoalsProgressService gives (programming_goals_progress_service.rb lines 20-36). wakatime-cli's --today prints grand_total.text, or the categories' texts when there are two or more (pkg/summary/summary.go), and Hackatime sends no categories.
